scope: All four public task descriptions. This is a released subset; the full-suite task denominator is unverified. Published model-run counts do not establish the number of independent tasks.

tasks.assessment: Public task descriptions assessed. Raw biological fixtures, answer vocabularies, grading answers and model trajectories were not inspected for training authoring; input formats include workflow prerequisites requiring schema verification.
required_stages: annotate measured cells with declared expression rules
construct spatial neighborhoods within valid section and field boundaries
compare heterotypic neighbor counts with a declared label-permutation null
rank enrichment and depletion with replicate-aware uncertainty
scientific_decisions: Specify distance units, neighborhood scale, section boundaries and null strata; hidden condition names need not be decoded.
remaining_gaps: Specify distance units, neighborhood scale, section boundaries and null strata; hidden condition names need not be decoded.
Inspect input schemas and screen independent biological lineages; author complete quantitative artifacts with deterministic acceptance rules.
Measure a coherent observed subset that preserves replication and the scientific comparison within the 30-minute limit.
